Name: Project Health Check
Purpose: Check whether the R&D Innovation project is working as designed.
Prompt: Review recent outputs, recurring failures, duplication, routing friction, stale prompts, excessive process, and regression results. Identify the smallest material gaps.

Name: Workstream Review
Purpose: Review one or more R&D workstreams for effectiveness and boundary problems.
Prompt: Check purpose, inputs, outputs, routing, tool use, prompt fit, evidence quality, handoffs, and overlap with other workstreams. Report concrete issues and evidence.

Name: Prompt Review
Purpose: Review a workstream Prompt.csv for redundancy, ambiguity and missing capability.
Prompt: Check prompt purpose, input/output contract, duplication, routing fit, guardrails, and whether the prompt causes unnecessary work. Propose only evidence-backed changes.

Name: Workflow Improvement
Purpose: Propose a workflow change based on an observed problem.
Prompt: State observed problem, affected workstream, root cause/hypothesis, proposed change, expected benefit, risks, compatibility impact, and regression test.

Name: Tool Selection Review
Purpose: Check whether tasks are using the appropriate tool.
Prompt: Compare task type with current tool rules. Identify unnecessary tool switching, missing capability, duplicate workflows, and simpler alternatives.

Name: Regression Review
Purpose: Review regression results after a Project Improvement change.
Prompt: Check pass/fail evidence, new regressions, false positives/negatives, and whether the change should be kept, revised, or rejected.

Name: Improvement Proposal
Prompt: Use ADD/UPDATE/REMOVE/NO_CHANGE where relevant. Define exact target state and verification criteria. Do not promote automatically.

Name: Project Instruction Review
Purpose: Review Project Instruction against actual usage and repository rules.
Prompt: Check scope, workstreams, tool rules, evidence discipline, guardrails, visualization, and self-improvement governance. Propose only changes supported by observed use or explicit decisions.
